candidate.title: The following embedded cache metrics are removed
candidate.text: The following embedded cache metrics are removed. Instead use `loki_cache_fetched_keys`, `loki_cache_hits`, `loki_cache_request_duration_seconds` which instruments requests made to the configured cache (`embeddedcache`, `memcached` or `redis`). - `querier_cache_added_total` - `querier_cache_gets_total` - `querier_cache_misses_total`

evidence.locator: L653-L656 (3.0.0 › Loki 3.0.0 › Embedded cache metric changes)
evidence.excerpt:
- The following embedded cache metrics are removed. Instead use `loki_cache_fetched_keys`, `loki_cache_hits`, `loki_cache_request_duration_seconds` which instruments requests made to the configured cache (`embeddedcache`, `memcached` or `redis`).
  - `querier_cache_added_total`
  - `querier_cache_gets_total`
  - `querier_cache_misses_total`
